title: Multifunctional performance of deep eutectic solvent (DES) K2CO3–glycerol in biodiesel synthesis and purification
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1789-1801
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09382A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Leily Nurul Komariah, Susila Arita, Muhammad Daffa Khairuddiin, Siti Alifah Ovindirani, Desi Erisna, Tsabita Nayaka Paramasyifa
This study introduces DES K2CO3–glycerol, a green chemical that demonstrates versatility and functioning simultaneously as both a catalyst and a solvent. It provides promising benefits in the production of sustainable and economical biodiesel.
